description: "New System of Domestic Cookery, formed upon Principles of Economy, and adapted…" by an anonymous author is a practical cookbook written in the early 19th century. This work aims to provide households with economical cooking methods and recipes, focusing on efficiency and frugality in the management of daily meals.
